intro.zh: 檢查你是否掌握 Claude 的基本概念：模型怎麼運作、提示詞、上下文與記憶、搜尋、Artifacts 與隱私。80 分通過。
intro.en: Check your grasp of Claude basics: how models work, prompting, context and memory, search, Artifacts and privacy. Pass at 80.

q.zh: 語言模型產生回答的基本方式是什麼？
q.en: How does a language model basically produce an answer?

opts.zh: 一次從資料庫挑出完整的標準答案
opts.en: Pick a complete standard answer from a database

opts.zh: 根據前文，一個 token 一個 token 地預測接下來的內容
opts.en: Predict the next token at a time based on the text so far

opts.zh: 把問題送給真人專家回覆
opts.en: Forward the question to a human expert

why.zh: 模型是依據已有的文字逐步預測後續內容，因此回答可能流暢卻不一定正確，重要資訊仍要查證。
why.en: The model predicts what comes next from the text so far, so answers can be fluent yet wrong; important facts still need checking.

q.zh: 下列哪一項是使用 Claude 的方式之一？
q.en: Which of these is one way to use Claude?

opts.zh: 只能透過網頁
opts.en: Only through the web

opts.zh: 網頁、桌面 App、手機 App，以及給開發者的 API
opts.en: Web, desktop app, mobile app, and the developer API

opts.zh: 只能在作業系統內建的小工具使用
opts.en: Only in an OS built-in widget

why.zh: 課程介紹的四個入口是網頁、桌面 App、手機 App 與 API。
why.en: The course covers four entry points: web, desktop app, mobile app and API.

q.zh: 好提示詞的五個要素是下列哪一組？
q.en: Which set lists the five elements of a good prompt?

opts.zh: 角色、目標、脈絡、限制、格式與範例
opts.en: Role, goal, context, constraints, format and examples

opts.zh: 標題、副標、段落、結語、署名
opts.en: Title, subtitle, paragraphs, closing, signature

opts.zh: 速度、價格、模型、方案、語言
opts.en: Speed, price, model, plan, language

why.zh: 缺什麼就補什麼：角色、目標、脈絡、限制，以及格式與範例。
why.en: Add whatever is missing: role, goal, context, constraints, and format with examples.

q.zh: 提示詞的「黃金法則」是什麼？
q.en: What is the "golden rule" of prompting?

opts.zh: 越短越好
opts.en: The shorter the better

opts.zh: 沒有背景的同事看得懂，Claude 就看得懂
opts.en: If a colleague with no background could understand it, Claude can too

opts.zh: 一定要用英文
opts.en: Always write in English

why.zh: 把背景、目的與期待交代清楚，是讓回答貼近需求最有效的方法。
why.en: Spelling out background, purpose and expectations is the most effective way to get a fitting answer.

q.zh: 對話非常長時，最需要注意什麼？
q.en: What matters most when a conversation gets very long?

opts.zh: Claude 一次能看到的內容有上限（上下文視窗），重要資訊要適時重申或整理
opts.en: Claude sees only a limited amount at once (the context window); restate or summarize key information

opts.zh: 對話越長 Claude 越聰明
opts.en: The longer it gets, the smarter Claude becomes

opts.zh: 長度完全不受限制
opts.en: There is no limit at all

why.zh: 上下文視窗有上限；長對話可開新對話並貼上摘要，或使用專案保存背景。
why.en: The context window is limited; start a new chat with a summary, or keep background in a project.

q.zh: 課程中提到的記憶控制包含哪三種？
q.en: Which three memory controls does the course mention?

opts.zh: 檢視與編輯、暫停、重設
opts.en: View and edit, pause, reset

opts.zh: 上傳、下載、列印
opts.en: Upload, download, print

opts.zh: 加密、壓縮、備份
opts.en: Encrypt, compress, back up

why.zh: 你可以檢視與編輯記憶內容、暫停記憶，或重設。
why.en: You can view and edit memory, pause it, or reset it.

q.zh: 什麼情況比較適合用「研究」功能而不是一般網頁搜尋？
q.en: When is research a better fit than ordinary web search?

opts.zh: 只需查一個簡單事實
opts.en: You need one simple fact

opts.zh: 需要多次蒐集並綜合多個來源，產出附引用的報告
opts.en: You need to gather and synthesize many sources into a cited report

opts.zh: 完全不需要最新資訊
opts.en: You need no up-to-date information

why.zh: 一兩次搜尋能解決的用網頁搜尋；需要五次以上工具呼叫的綜合蒐集才適合研究。
why.en: One or two searches suit web search; synthesis needing five or more tool calls suits research.

q.zh: 拿到附引用的答案後，最好的做法是？
q.en: After receiving an answer with citations, what is the best practice?

opts.zh: 有引用就一定正確，直接採用
opts.en: Citations mean it's right; use it directly

opts.zh: 點開來源核對：來源是否可信、內容是否真的支持該結論
opts.en: Open the sources and check they are credible and really support the claim

opts.zh: 刪掉引用以節省版面
opts.en: Delete the citations to save space

why.zh: 引用讓你能回頭查證，但仍要確認來源可信且與結論相符。
why.en: Citations let you verify, but you still confirm the source is credible and matches the claim.

q.zh: Artifact 適合用在哪種情況？
q.en: When is an Artifact a good fit?

opts.zh: 簡短的是非題回答
opts.en: A short yes/no answer

opts.zh: 內容較大且獨立、之後可能再編輯或重用，例如網頁、文件或小工具
opts.en: Large, self-contained content you may edit or reuse, such as a page, document or small tool

opts.zh: 刪除舊對話
opts.en: Deleting old chats

why.zh: Artifact 在對話旁打開，可反覆修改，完成後再決定是否分享。
why.en: An Artifact opens beside the chat, can be revised repeatedly, and is shared only when you decide.

q.zh: 下列哪一項是處理敏感資料較穩妥的做法？
q.en: Which is the safer way to handle sensitive data?

opts.zh: 把客戶個資完整貼進對話
opts.en: Paste full customer personal data into the chat

opts.zh: 去識別化或遮蔽後再貼，並了解方案的資料保存與模型改善設定
opts.en: De-identify or mask it first, and understand your plan's retention and model-improvement settings

opts.zh: 認為 AI 不會保存任何資料
opts.en: Assume AI never retains anything

why.zh: 先去識別化、了解資料設定，必要時使用無痕對話或確認單位規範。
why.en: De-identify first, understand data settings, and use incognito chats or check organization policy when needed.
